model.frozen_association_ablation: Initial PCA predicted path IDs are frozen to observed arrival ranks; final state is also scored under the original exact sorted objective.
model.conditional_timing_ablation: Linear least-squares estimate of additive source emission and microphone clock terms conditional on blind candidate coordinates; engineering diagnostic, not a paper-derived estimator.
model.wall_only_ablation: C9 wall-only echo fitting with blind direct state held fixed and PCA wall initialization; C9 finite-face penalty retained and labelled. Truth planes enter scoring only.
